required_actions.title: Driver Collection Detection
required_actions.description: Detect driver-side collection of distributed data.
required_actions.recommendation: Avoid collecting large distributed datasets to the driver.

required_actions.title: Large Driver Collection Risk
required_actions.description: Detect collect() calls evaluated against data evidence. An unrestricted collect() over a large input risks driver memory pressure/OOM, while the same call after limit() or on a small input is a qualified warning.
required_actions.recommendation: Potential large driver-side collection: materializing 2048 GB on the driver risks memory pressure/OOM; keep data distributed (write/aggregate) or bound the result.

required_actions.title: toPandas Large Data Risk
required_actions.description: Detect toPandas() calls evaluated against data evidence. A bounded toPandas() (e.g. after limit()) is a qualified warning; an unbounded call over a large input is high risk. toPandas() is not banned.
required_actions.recommendation: Potential large toPandas() over ~2048 GB: prefer distributed writes/aggregates or Arrow-based bounded transfer.

required_actions.title: Cartesian Cross Join Risk
required_actions.description: Detect crossJoin() or join(how="cross"). Cartesian products produce multiplicative row growth (O(N*M)), leading to massive shuffles, performance degradation, and executor OOM.
required_actions.recommendation: Dangerous cross join over ~2048 GB: Cartesian product causes multiplicative row growth (O(N*M)) and catastrophic shuffle/OOM.

required_actions.title: Driver Memory Exhaustion Risk at Scale
required_actions.description: Driver-side materialization (`collect`/`toPandas`) detected in pipeline code combined with a substantial data workload (3072.0 GB). Materializing distributed datasets to the Spark driver causes out-of-memory driver crashes.
required_actions.recommendation: Replace `collect()` and `toPandas()` with distributed DataFrame actions or write transformations directly to Delta lake.

required_actions.title: Cartesian Product Scaling Risk
required_actions.description: Cartesian cross join detected on a non-trivial workload (3072.0 GB). Unconstrained cross joins generate O(N*M) record explosions at scale, saturating executor disk and network.
required_actions.recommendation: Eliminate Cartesian joins: supply explicit join conditions with ON clauses or apply strict pre-filtering.

required_actions.title: Pandas UDF Misuse Detection
required_actions.description: Detect use of Pandas UDF where native Spark UDF would be more appropriate.
required_actions.recommendation: Consider using native Spark UDF or vectorized Pandas UDF (applyInPlace) for better performance.

required_actions.title: Show() in Production Path Detection
required_actions.description: Detect show() or take() calls in production pipeline code paths.
required_actions.recommendation: Replace show()/take() with proper logging or remove from production code paths.

required_actions.title: Hard-coded Path Detection
required_actions.description: Detect hard-coded file paths in pipeline code.
required_actions.recommendation: Use configuration or environment variables for file paths.

required_actions.title: Potential Large Shuffle
required_actions.description: Flag shuffle-class operations (groupBy, distinct, repartition, orderBy, large joins, windows) over sizable inputs as potential shuffle risk. Static analysis cannot prove shuffle volume, so findings are WARN only.
required_actions.recommendation: Potential shuffle risk: join() over ~2048 GB — confirm partitioning and skew handling; static analysis cannot prove shuffle volume.

required_actions.title: User Defined Function (UDF) Overhead Risk
required_actions.description: Detect Python and Pandas UDF usages. Standard Python UDFs force row-by-row serialization across the Python-JVM boundary, incurring severe performance penalties on large datasets. Prefer native Spark SQL/DataFrame expressions or vectorized Pandas UDFs.
required_actions.recommendation: Python UDF over a large input forces row-wise serialization; prefer native Spark SQL/DataFrame expressions where appropriate.

required_actions.title: Missing Retry Configuration

required_actions.recommendation: Configure retry count (>= 1) on production tasks to prevent transient failure pipeline interruptions.

required_actions.description: Calculates deterministic compound data growth projections over the forecast horizon.
required_actions.recommendation: Under configured growth assumptions, workload will exceed current thresholds. Plan partition maintenance and adjust cluster sizing.

required_actions.description: Evaluates driver-side materialization (collect, toPandas) in the context of scaled data volume.
required_actions.recommendation: Replace `collect()` and `toPandas()` with distributed DataFrame transformations or write directly to storage to prevent driver OOM.

observed.code_snippet:
"""Deliberately bad production pipeline fixture: full reload + driver ops, no retries."""

from pyspark.sql.functions import udf
from pyspark.sql.types import StringType

df = spark.read.format("parquet").load("abfss://landing@acct.dfs.core.windows.net/bad_production/")

# Driver-side collection of a distributed dataset (CODE-PYSPARK-001, blocking)
rows = df.collect()

# Pandas conversion on the driver (large-data risk)
pdf = df.toPandas()

# Python UDF instead of native Spark SQL (CODE-PYSPARK-002)
shout = udf(lambda s: s.upper(), StringType())
df2 = df.withColumn("name_upper", shout("name"))

# Debug action left in production path (CODE-PYSPARK-003)
df2.show()
first = df2.take(5)

# Cartesian product without a join key (CODE-PYSPARK-004)
pairs = df.crossJoin(df.limit(100))

# Hard-coded local path (CODE-PYSPARK-005)
pairs.write.parquet("/tmp/bad_production_output")

# Hard-coded credential (CP-020 must flag; value must be masked in reports)
password = [MASKED_SECRET]

# Unnecessary repeated repartition (CODE-PYSPARK-009)
huge = df.repartition(200)
huge = huge.repartition(50)

# Global sort over the huge frame (CODE-PYSPARK-013)
sorted_huge = huge.orderBy("name")

# Repeated actions on one frame (CODE-PYSPARK-012)
print(df.count())
print(df.count())

# Cache with no demonstrated reuse (CODE-PYSPARK-011)
df.cache()
df.write.parquet("/tmp/bad_production_output2")

# No try/except, no restart config, no retries/timeout (see contract).

evidence.recommendation: Avoid collecting large distributed datasets to the driver.

required_evidence: Remediate Driver Memory Exhaustion Risk at Scale: Replace `collect()` and `toPandas()` with distributed DataFrame actions or write transformations directly to Delta lake.

remediations.title: Resolve Blocker: Cartesian Product Scaling Risk
remediations.description: Cartesian cross join detected on a non-trivial workload (3072.0 GB). Unconstrained cross joins generate O(N*M) record explosions at scale, saturating executor disk and network.
required_evidence: Remediate Cartesian Product Scaling Risk: Eliminate Cartesian joins: supply explicit join conditions with ON clauses or apply strict pre-filtering.

remediations.title: Resolve Blocker: High Network Shuffle & Spill Risk
remediations.description: Observed or projected shuffle volume exceeds safe network thresholds, causing executor memory spill to disk and stage stragglers.
required_evidence: Remediate High Network Shuffle & Spill Risk: Enable Adaptive Query Execution (AQE), co-partition datasets on join keys, and avoid wide transformations before filtering.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Missing Incremental Strategy
remediations.description: Flag large-volume sources with no incremental ingestion evidence (no incremental/CDC/streaming mode and no watermark, CDC, checkpoint, or partitioning evidence).
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Pandas UDF Misuse Detection
remediations.description: Detect use of Pandas UDF where native Spark UDF would be more appropriate.
required_evidence: Operational risk associated with Pandas UDF Misuse Detection.
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Show() in Production Path Detection
remediations.description: Detect show() or take() calls in production pipeline code paths.
required_evidence: Operational risk associated with Show() in Production Path Detection.
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Hard-coded Path Detection
remediations.description: Detect hard-coded file paths in pipeline code.
required_evidence: Operational risk associated with Hard-coded Path Detection.
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Potential Large Shuffle
remediations.description: Flag shuffle-class operations (groupBy, distinct, repartition, orderBy, large joins, windows) over sizable inputs as potential shuffle risk. Static analysis cannot prove shuffle volume, so findings are WARN only.
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: User Defined Function (UDF) Overhead Risk
remediations.description: Detect Python and Pandas UDF usages. Standard Python UDFs force row-by-row serialization across the Python-JVM boundary, incurring severe performance penalties on large datasets. Prefer native Spark SQL/DataFrame expressions or vectorized Pandas UDFs.
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Data Growth Risk: FAIL
remediations.description: Calculates deterministic compound data growth projections over the forecast horizon.
required_evidence: Configured growth rate (15.0%) projects data volume to expand from 3072.0 GB to 4062.7 GB over the forecast horizon
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Driver Scalability Risk: FAIL
remediations.description: Evaluates driver-side materialization (collect, toPandas) in the context of scaled data volume.
required_evidence: Driver-side materialization detected (2 collect/toPandas call(s)) combined with a substantial data workload (3072.0 GB)
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Join Scalability Risk: FAIL
remediations.description: Evaluates join architecture to prevent Cartesian row explosion and unbounded shuffle joins at scale.
required_evidence: Cartesian cross join detected: PySpark crossJoin() call. At 3072.0 GB workload, Cartesian product produces severe scaling risk
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Mitigate High Risk: Missing Retry Configuration
remediations.description: Detects production jobs or tasks without retry configuration where resilience is required.
remediations.expected_outcome: Eliminates high operational or data integrity risk.

remediations.title: Address Warning: CrossJoin Detection
remediations.description: Detect crossJoin operations which can produce cartesian products.
required_evidence: Operational risk associated with CrossJoin Detection.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Potential Excessive Repartition
remediations.description: Flag repeated repartition() calls on one DataFrame or unnecessarily large literal partition counts. A single reasonable repartition is not flagged.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Unjustified Cache
remediations.description: Flag cache()/persist() where static analysis shows no demonstrated reuse of the cached DataFrame. Reused frames are not flagged, and no runtime benefit is ever claimed without runtime evidence.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Repeated Spark Action
remediations.description: Flag multiple actions (count/collect/take/show/write) on one DataFrame, which may require additional computation. count() alone is never bad.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Large Dataset Global Sort
remediations.description: Flag global orderBy()/sort() over large inputs as a potential performance warning — never a definite failure without runtime evidence.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Missing Task Timeout
remediations.description: Detects production tasks without an explicit timeout configured.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Peak Workload Capacity Headroom Risk
remediations.description: Contractual peak ingestion burst exceeds baseline workload capacity on a fixed or constrained cluster configuration without empirical verification.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Insufficient Evidence: SLA_COMPLIANCE
remediations.description: SLA compliance cannot be determined without runtime duration telemetry.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Insufficient Evidence: IDEMPOTENCY_SAFETY
remediations.description: MERGE key stability/uniqueness unproven; idempotency cannot be certified safe.

remediations.title: Address Warning: Insufficient Evidence: COST_VIABILITY
remediations.description: Cost projection unavailable in offline static analysis without DBU consumption telemetry.

remediations.title: Provide Telemetry Evidence
remediations.description: Supply Databricks runtime execution telemetry (run duration, task metrics, shuffle bytes) to enable performance, SLA, and cost decision sufficiency.
required_evidence: Supply Databricks runtime execution telemetry (run duration, task metrics, shuffle bytes) to enable performance, SLA, and cost decision sufficiency.
remediations.expected_outcome: Achieves full evidence coverage and decision sufficiency.
